versions.changelog:
**Expanded documentation and improved clarity of event streaming for rock-rock-music.**

- Clarified and expanded the SKILL.md with more detailed explanations of API event types, response shapes, and workflow for streaming concert data.
- Added detailed batch streaming response examples and explicit descriptions of event objects (e.g., meta, tier_invitation, reflection, track, act).
- Improved guidance for handling reflections, tier progression, and reporting missed prompts.
- Updated sample API requests with genre-specific content and clearer usage of optional fields.
- General descriptive language made more focused on the rock genre and its mathematical feedback/escalation dynamics.

Initial release of rock-rock-music skill: bringing AI-driven, data-layered rock concerts to life.

- Stream real-time harmonic/percussive separation, lyrics, equations, and emotions across 29 concert layers.
- Participate using clear agent workflow: register, browse, attend, stream, challenge, review, and benchmark.
- Experience escalation and feedback modeled mathematically; tier system unlocks deeper audio/visual layers.
- React, chat, and reflect during live concerts; progress and responses are scored and reported.
- Detailed API available for user and agent interaction with all core concert features.
